description: Add or overwrite a script on a dashboard.

dashboard_id.description: The ID of the dashboard where the script will be added.

script.description: The JavaScript script to add, provided as either a properly formatted JSON string, a raw multi-line script string, or a pre-built payload dictionary.

executing_user.description: The username of the API user, used to temporarily change the owner of the dashboard, as only the owner can add scripts. If not provided, assumes the dashboard owner is the same as the API user.

examples.user_query: How can I add a script to the dashboard with ID 'dashboard123'?
examples.notes: This call adds a JavaScript script to the dashboard with ID 'dashboard123', temporarily changing ownership to 'admin_user' if necessary.

examples.user_query: I need to overwrite the script on dashboard 'sales_dashboard' with a new one. How do I do that?

arguments.script: """function onLoad() { alert('Welcome to the Sales Dashboard!'); }"""

examples.notes: This call overwrites the existing script on the 'sales_dashboard' dashboard with a new script. Ownership change is not required since 'executing_user' is omitted.

examples.user_query: Can I add a script to the dashboard 'marketing_dashboard' without specifying an executing user?
examples.notes: This call adds a script to the 'marketing_dashboard' dashboard. Since 'executing_user' is not provided, the API assumes the dashboard owner is the same as the API user.

description: Add or overwrite a script for a specific widget within a dashboard.

dashboard_id.description: The ID of the dashboard containing the widget.

widget_id.description: The ID of the widget where the script will be added.

script.description: The JavaScript script to add, provided as either a properly formatted JSON string, a raw multi-line script string, or a pre-built payload dictionary.

executing_user.description: The username of the API user, used to temporarily change the owner of the dashboard, as only the owner can add scripts. If not provided, assumes the dashboard owner is the same as the API user.

examples.user_query: How can I add a custom script to the sales widget in my dashboard?
examples.notes: This call adds a custom JavaScript script to the widget with ID 'widget_67890' in the dashboard 'dashboard_12345'. The 'executing_user' temporarily takes ownership to perform this action.

examples.user_query: I need to overwrite the script for the revenue chart widget in the financial dashboard.
examples.notes: This call overwrites the existing script for the widget 'revenue_chart_001' in the 'financial_dashboard_2023'. The 'finance_manager' user temporarily assumes ownership to make this change.

examples.user_query: Can I add a multi-line script to the KPI widget in the executive dashboard?
examples.notes: This call adds a multi-line JavaScript script to the widget 'kpi_widget_42' in the 'exec_dashboard_001'. The 'executive_admin' user temporarily assumes ownership to perform this action.
